es: Transmitir mensajes entre tres personas con fidelidad: dos mensajes, una pregunta reportada y una aclaración de lo que se dijo exactamente.

teaching.en: Tom asked me to pass on a message to you: he will be late.
teaching.es: Tom me pidió que te transmitiera un mensaje: llegará tarde.
teaching.explanationEs: Asked me to + verbo: un encargo; el mensaje cambia de persona (I/you).
segments: Tom asked me to pass on a
message to you: he will be late.
teaching.audioText: Tom asked me to pass on a message to you: he will be late.

teaching.en: Mia left a message: she wants to know if you can bring the tickets.
teaching.es: Mia dejó un mensaje: quiere saber si puedes traer las entradas.
teaching.explanationEs: Wants to know + if: pregunta reportada, con orden normal y sin signo de pregunta.
segments: Mia left a message: she wants to
know if you can bring the tickets.
teaching.audioText: Mia left a message: she wants to know if you can bring the tickets.

teaching.en: Let me clarify: she didn't say she would come; she said she might.
teaching.es: Déjame aclararlo: no dijo que vendría; dijo que quizá vendría.
teaching.explanationEs: Clarify: corrige un reporte con didn't say… she said….
segments: Let me clarify: she didn't say she
would come; she said she might.
teaching.audioText: Let me clarify: she didn't say she would come; she said she might.

teaching.en: No, that is not exactly what he said: he warned us not to park there.
teaching.es: No, eso no es exactamente lo que dijo: nos advirtió que no aparcáramos allí.
teaching.explanationEs: Exactly marca que quieres recuperar las palabras precisas de quien habló.
segments: No, that is not exactly what he said:
he warned us not to park there.
teaching.audioText: No, that is not exactly what he said: he warned us not to park there.

teaching.en: Sorry, there was a misunderstanding: what I meant was that we should start at nine.
teaching.es: Perdón, hubo un malentendido: lo que quise decir era que deberíamos empezar a las nueve.
teaching.explanationEs: What I meant was… corrige un malentendido de tu propio mensaje.
segments: Sorry, there was a misunderstanding: what I meant
was that we should start at nine.
teaching.audioText: Sorry, there was a misunderstanding: what I meant was that we should start at nine.

teaching.en: Can you pass on my message to Leo? Tell him that the meeting is on Friday.
teaching.es: ¿Puedes hacerle llegar mi mensaje a Leo? Dile que la reunión es el viernes.
teaching.explanationEs: Tell him that + presente: el hecho sigue siendo cierto, así que no retrocede el tiempo.
segments: Can you pass on my message to Leo?
Tell him that the meeting is on Friday.
teaching.audioText: Can you pass on my message to Leo? Tell him that the meeting is on Friday.

prompt.es: ¿Cómo pasa Sara el mensaje a Leo?

choices.text: Carlos asked me to tell you that the meeting starts at nine.
Carlos asked me that I tell you the meeting starts at nine.
Carlos asked me to say you that the meeting starts at nine.

feedback.es: El encargo se pasa con asked me to + verbo. Las otras dos usan that o dicen say you.

hint.es: Asked me to + verbo es la estructura para pasar un encargo.

origin.text: Carlos to Sara: «Tell Leo that the meeting starts at nine.»

prompt.es: Completa: «Mia quiere saber si puedes traer las entradas.»

feedback.es: La pregunta reportada se introduce con if o whether y mantiene el orden you can.

hint.es: Después de la palabra que introduce la pregunta va el sujeto, sin inversión.

origin.text: Mia wants to know ___ you can bring the tickets.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Carlos te pidió que lo llamaras mañana.»

answer.text: Carlos asked you to call him tomorrow

feedback.es: Asked + persona + to + verbo base: el encargo que recibes.

hint.es: Empieza por quién pide y sigue con asked you.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué debes transmitir a Ana.

choices.text: That the concert is on Friday, and where she will sit.
That the concert is cancelled, and whether she wants a refund.
That the money is lost, and why she is late.

feedback.es: Hay un mensaje (el concierto se cancela) y una pregunta (si quiere que le devuelvan el dinero). Las otras opciones inventan datos.

origin.audio: Tell Ana the concert is cancelled, and ask her if she wants her money back.

choices.text: He promises to come.
He asks a question about the party.
He clarifies what he really said.

feedback.es: «I said I might come, not that I would» corrige un reporte: aclara lo que dijo de verdad. No promete ni pregunta.

origin.text: Leo says: «I said I might come, not that I would!»

prompt.es: Relaciona cada frase con lo que transmite.

pairs: Mia asked me to tell you that the game starts at five.
She wants to know if you can come.
That's not exactly what she said.
He warned us not to be late.

feedback.es: Cada frase cumple una función al transmitir: mensaje, pregunta, aclaración o advertencia.

pairs: Mia asked me to tell you that the game starts at five.
She wants to know if you can come.
That's not exactly what she said.
He warned us not to be late.

prompt.es: ¿Qué verbo de reporte resume mejor lo que hizo Sam?

choices.text: warned
admitted
wondered

feedback.es: Sam avisa de un peligro con «You must not open the door!»: eso es warned. Admitted sería reconocer algo y wondered, preguntarse.

origin.text: Sam said: «You must not open the door! It's dangerous!»

choices.text: She accused him to break the window.
She accused him of breaking the window.
She accused him for break the window.

feedback.es: Accuse + persona + of + -ing. Las otras usan to + verbo o for + verbo base.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige si el reporte de Ana es fiel.

choices.text: Yes, Ana kept Leo's meaning.
No, Ana changed the day.
No, Ana turned a possibility into a promise.

feedback.es: Might es una posibilidad y promised es un compromiso: Ana distorsiona lo que dijo Leo.

origin.audio: Leo said he might bring the cake. Later, Ana told us that Leo had promised to bring the cake.

prompt.es: Escribe el mensaje que pasas a Leo: dos mensajes y una pregunta.

answer.text: Carlos said that the meeting is on Friday, he asked you to bring the report, and he wants to know if you can arrive early.
accepted: Carlos said that the meeting is on Friday, he asked you to bring the report, and he wants to know if you can arrive early.
Carlos told me that the meeting is on Friday. He asked you to bring the report and wants to know if you can come early.
Carlos said the meeting is on Friday, asked you to bring the report, and wants to know whether you can arrive early.

feedback.es: El mensaje se pasa con said/told that, el encargo con asked you to y la pregunta con wants to know if, sin inversión.

origin.text: Datos: Carlos dijo que la reunión es el viernes; te pidió que lleves el informe; quiere saber si puedes llegar temprano.

prompt.es: ¿Cómo pasas la pregunta de Mia a Tom?

choices.text: Mia asked if you had seen her keys.
Mia asked did you see her keys.
Mia asked that you saw her keys.

feedback.es: La pregunta reportada usa if, orden normal y el tiempo un paso atrás (had seen). Las otras invierten el orden o usan that.

origin.text: Mia says: «Did you see my keys? I can't find them.»

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué hace la persona.

choices.text: Making a promise.
Clarifying a misunderstanding.
Asking for help.

feedback.es: Corrige lo que se entendió mal («That's not what I meant»): aclara un malentendido.

origin.audio: That's not what I meant. I wanted to say that we should start at nine, not at eight.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Te pidió que le mandaras un mensaje.»

answer.text: He asked you to send him a message

feedback.es: Se pasa un encargo con asked you to + verbo base; el complemento him sustituye a la persona que recibirá el mensaje.
